source: Guided Learning Mode Lab Procedure Specification

steps.title: IC Placement
steps.instruction: Insert IC package on solderless breadboard across center DIP gap.

steps.title: Connect VCC Power (+5V)
steps.instruction: Draw a Red wire from +5V Rail to Pin 14.

steps.title: Connect GND Ground
steps.instruction: Draw a Black wire from GND Rail to Pin 7.

steps.title: Wire Input Switches
steps.instruction: Connect Switch A to Pin 1 and Switch B to Pin 2.

steps.title: Wire Output LED & Resistor
steps.instruction: Connect Output Pin 3 to LED Anode and Cathode through 330Ω Resistor to GND.

steps.title: Run Simulation & Observation
steps.instruction: Click ▶ Start Simulation. Toggle switches to verify live observation truth table.
